statement: Per wire coverage of the same earnings, Marvell raised its fiscal 2028 revenue outlook to approximately $18 billion from about $16.5 billion, with data-center revenue expected to grow more than 60% and the custom business expected to more than double year over year in fiscal 2028.
why: A doubling of custom accelerator business points to hyperscalers putting more of their compute budget into in-house silicon programs alongside merchant GPUs.

impact.mechanism: Rising custom-silicon design wins add to total AI accelerator demand while also giving hyperscalers an alternative to buying merchant GPUs.

evidence.excerpt: Marvell raised its fiscal 2028 revenue outlook to approximately $18 billion
a significant acceleration in our Custom business beginning in the second half of fiscal 2027.

confidence.basis: The fiscal 2028 target is relayed inside this document as wire coverage of the earnings rather than quoted from the release itself.
